{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Magnum Gas Storage Header Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-05-06/html/2025-07874.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Utah to Goshen, Utah.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Magnum Gas Storage LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-05-06/html/2025-07874.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''1,200 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''61.6 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-05-06/html/2025-07874.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-05-06/html/2025-07874.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Proposed<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-05-06/html/2025-07874.htm|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
